materialChanges: Reframed empirical-rule band counts as an informal directional diagnostic rather than a universal retain-or-reject test, and aligned the objective, instruction, practice, assessment and feedback with the need for a normal probability plot or calibrated procedure.

Disclosed that the underlying 60 cohort observations are absent, treated their counts and summaries as stipulated teaching inputs, and removed their use as reproducible evidence that the normal model passed a fit check.

Made the binomial worked examples explicitly homogeneous and independent, corrected the fourth conditions check, distinguished a single-quarter count spread from a between-quarter difference, and withdrew operational capacity conclusions based on a common probability contradicted by the cohort strata.

Corrected the z-score assessment to ask about a percentile claim, the length-of-stay impossible probability and support-versus-skew distinction, the unsupported physiological account of glucose skew, and the rounded status of the empirical-rule percentages.
Added the two required worked-example self-explanation prompts while preserving the original opening, instructional arc, chart data and unaffected practice.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The one-or-two-person cutoff was removed. Scene 3 now explains sampling variation and fitted-parameter limits, scenes 5 and 7 use tail counts only as directional warnings, lesson.json teaches the diagnostic/calibrated distinction, and assessment requires an appropriate plot or calibrated procedure for a binary fit decision.

The revision explicitly states in scenes 1, 3 and 9 and in ATTRIBUTION.md that the underlying 60 readings are absent. Counts, median, skewness and extrema are now stipulated inputs, not independently reproducible evidence of model acceptance, and downstream cohort calculations are labelled conditional.

Scene 6 now separates homogeneous worked examples from the heterogeneous cohort, gives coherent subgroup probabilities whose equal-weight average is 0.81, and keys the fourth check as indefensible. Scene 9 no longer recommends a single-binomial capacity interval and requires a justified common probability or separately modelled strata.

The assessment prompt now makes an approximately 92nd-percentile claim. Its answer correctly requires both a named reference distribution and a supported shape for the distance-to-percentile conversion, while retaining the distinction between a z-score and a clinical judgment.

Scene 8 now evaluates the actual one-day floor as z approximately -0.897 and P(X < 1) approximately 0.185, explains that 2.275 per cent is only a subset, and bases the skew inference on the mean-median relationship rather than support. The glossary and assessment now state that a lower bound alone does not force right skew.

The unsupported physiological mechanism and effectively unbounded-tail language were removed. Scene 5 now limits the evidence to the sourced empirical right skew and log transformation, and claims.json no longer represents the removed explanation as lesson reasoning.

Scene 6 now identifies 3.04 patients as the standard deviation of one quarterly count and gives sqrt(2) times 3.04, or 4.30 patients, as the standard deviation of the difference between independent quarters under the stated assumptions.

Scene 2, claim-empirical-rule-areas and term-empirical-rule now identify 68.27, 95.45 and 99.73 per cent as rounded decimal representations of cumulative normal-curve areas rather than exact percentages.
This note independently confirmed the screening chart's 1000-bin total, midpoint mean, population standard deviation and high-tail count. Those chart data and summaries were preserved unchanged.
The scene 3 worked example now ends with a self-explanation prompt asking why treating counts as an informal diagnostic is the decisive expert choice.
The scene 6 worked example now ends with a self-explanation prompt about why independent people from one homogeneous group are required for the binomial model.

The reviewer recorded a positive first-read note and requested no change. The concrete opening, separation of statistical and clinical meanings, and learner-facing tone were preserved; only the later objective summary and data boundary were narrowed for academic accuracy.

The reviewer recorded a positive transfer-design note and requested no change. The novel length-of-stay context and transfer operation were preserved while the probability and support-versus-skew statements were corrected in response to the academic review.

Both declarative charts retain concise alt text, outcome-relevant long descriptions and inspectable numeric series; the prose and tables provide a complete nonvisual route without color, hover, drag, sound, motion or timing.
Important equations remain dollar-delimited or directive-delimited mathematics with adjacent prose calculations and interpretations; the new Phi notation is defined in words.
No raw HTML, HTML entities, Markdown images, remote embeds, executable content, active media, path traversal, personal data or real-patient records were introduced.

lesson.json declares CC BY 4.0, no third-party assets, the accountable author and material agent assistance; ATTRIBUTION.md distinguishes original constructed material and now discloses the absent cohort observations.

Every reference remains a facts-only use with concrete rights-basis evidence, a displayed licence, dated checked-no-agent-restriction-found access status and an HTTPS terms route; no human-only source or reused third-party expression, media or dataset is present.
The educational and non-clinical boundary is repeated where clinical thresholds and invented services appear, and the assessment does not direct diagnosis, treatment or personal testing.
Claim IDs, scene IDs and source IDs resolve after the revision; the added length-of-stay claim mapping is exposed in the same-scene source note.

Both are request-changes inputs from distinct declared runs and providers; zero approvals and two change requests are recorded rather than obscured. All thirteen indexed findings have concrete dispositions, every major academic or learning-design defect was incorporated, and the chart-verification and positive learning-design notes required no substantive change. The final source is academically coherent within its explicit data boundary, preserves assessment alignment and first-read quality, and satisfies the finalizer's source-based accessibility-and-rights audit. Static checks confirmed JSON syntax, fixed lesson identity, string acceptable responses, scene-minute totals, heading structure, safe Markdown, claim/source resolution, rights-ledger completeness and corrected calculations. Subject to the recorded operator-only commit stamping and repository-validation conditions, no credible content, accessibility, rights, safety or provenance blocker remains, so the evidence supports merge.
dissent: Both eligible advisory reviews requested changes against the original candidate; their objections remain visible in the review artifacts and are answered finding by finding rather than treated as approvals of the final edit.

The learning-design reviewer declared that the same GitHub principal operates authoring, review and finalization runs. Agent run IDs and providers are disclosed and internally distinct, but this is attested founding-stage provenance rather than verified human independence.
